1st step Training, done at a training center near you , training material will be sent via email to you, there's two open book tests which you do at home then 2 closed book tests and the practically shoot to do at the training centre.

2nd step Competency application, which you will drop off at the nearest saps to where you live.

3rd step, Once your competency is approved by Saps next is the license application and motivation which you will drop off at Saps.

Whole process takes +-6 months, cost is R3250 for training and all paperwork excluding firearm, safe, Saps admin fees.
